zh: 及浩將北伐，羲之以為必敗，以書止之，言甚切至。
before: When Hao was about to conduct a northern expedition, Xizhi thought it would certainly fail, and with a letter stopped him; the words were very urgent and thorough.
after: When Hao was about to conduct a northern expedition, Xizhi thought it would certainly fail, and tried to stop him with a letter; the words were very urgent and thorough.
unchangedPairedIdiomatic: When Yin Hao prepared a northern campaign, Wang Xizhi was convinced it would end in disaster and sent him a letter urging him to desist, in the frankest terms.
reason: 以書止之 describes an attempt to dissuade Yin Hao; the next unit says 浩遂行, so the campaign was not actually stopped. This precise correction is already independently approved and merged; it is not a new pending repair. Deployment remains pending.
